subject.title: [codex] fix(sessions): report archive cleanup in sessions cleanup

question: Do the PR's agent-scoped skip, all-agent deduplication, and explicit `--store` full-directory cleanup rules match the intended destructive archive ownership contract?
rationale: Green tests prove the implemented rules, but repository evidence does not establish that explicit-store cleanup may permanently delete every matching archive in a directory that could contain multiple logical owners.

options.title: Approve current ownership rules
options.body: Accept the tested three-mode contract and land the PR after a final merge-result review.

options.title: Require per-archive ownership
options.body: Narrow deletion so every archive must be attributable to the selected agent or store before removal.

options.title: Ship reporting only
options.body: Keep preview and apply summaries but defer physical archive deletion until ownership metadata is stronger.
